template: generate_three_view.sh: clean orthographic FRONT / SIDE / BACK sheet, same scale, metre dimension lines, cozy ancient-Chinese xianxia riverside forest village (Qingxi), painterly realistic stylized game art, warm grey stone, aged wood, grass green, moss; no characters or extra text. Subject: <below>
A01: low grassy slope terrain block: modular 4 m x 4 m ground tile rising 0.6 m from one edge to the other as a gentle walkable slope, short meadow grass and clover on top, exposed warm-grey layered stone and embedded rounded rocks on the cut sides, dark soil strata, neat flat edges so tiles can join.
A02: forest hollow terrain block: modular 6 m x 6 m tile with a shallow bowl 0.5 m deep, leaf litter and short grass inside, a small rabbit burrow in the BACK inner slope (spawn point), a clearly gentler, wider grassy ramp on the FRONT side as the exit path; ferns and exposed roots on the rim, warm-grey stones and soil strata on the cut sides; flat outer edges for tiling.
A03: fallen log crossing: trunk about 5 m long, 0.55 m diameter; upturned root plate with soil and stones at one end, jagged broken top at the other; the middle rests on a flat rock so its top is about 0.7 m high there and can be climbed over, with walk-around space past the root end; thick moss, peeling bark, shelf fungus, short branch stubs.
A04: mossy boulder cover: cluster of rounded granite boulders, 1.8 m wide, 1.3 m deep, 1.4 m tall overall (crouch cover), one large main boulder with two smaller ones, moss on tops and north side, ferns and grass at the base, firmly embedded in soil.
A05: layered standing rock cover: upright sedimentary slab 2.4 m wide, 0.9 m deep, 2.1 m tall, horizontal strata in warm grey and ochre, broad flat face for side cover, a small ledge halfway up, lichen, fallen flat stones and grass at the base, firmly embedded.
A06: low tree root obstacle: old cut stump 0.8 m diameter, 0.45 m tall, gnarled roots spreading about 2.6 m x 2.2 m, every root clearly diving into the soil (not claw-like, not monstrous), moss in root crooks, soil and leaf litter, roots under 0.35 m so they can be stepped over.
A07: rabbit trail mud tile 4 x 2 m, 0.15 m thick: trampled damp earth run through short grass, paired fore paw prints and longer hind prints, droppings, shed fur on a grass stem, flattened grass; no glowing lines.
A08: damaged bamboo fence 3 m long, 1.3 m tall: bamboo poles lashed to two rails between three wooden posts; middle broken: two poles snapped and leaning, one fallen, loose rope; safe/wild boundary.
A09: stone rain shelter 2.2 x 1.6 x 2.4 m: dry-stone back and side walls, single-pitch grey clay tile roof on two beams, open front, stone bench, lantern niche, moss, flat entrance step.
A10: wooden watch platform: deck 2.0 x 2.0 m at 1.8 m, four log legs with cross bracing, 7-rung ladder on the front, low log rail on three sides, rope lashings; overall 2.8 m.
A11: cloth warning rack 1.4 x 1.9 m: two posts and a crossbar, three faded red-ochre and indigo cloth strips with dried grass bundles, notched tally plank (no text), feathers, three-stone cairn; no glowing symbols.
A12: vine-wrapped training dummy 1.7 m: wooden post in a stone base, body of twisted vines and straw bound by three rope bands, two wrapped arm stubs, woven-vine head, loose vine ends; intact (a worn variant follows).
